Question: Dear Scholer I am hotel management graduate and iam working as proffesor in college of hotel managament teaching students subject of tourism managemnt and front office operation . is my earning halal. Answer ID: 5839 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1040/912=B/1429) If you do not teach any un-Islamic subject then your work is right and your earnings are halal . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
